HEEWON STYLE — a premium KOREAN WEBTOON / MANHWA splash illustration of a group, lit with cinematic tenebrism. A 2:1 movie frame composed for a 2:1 letterbox crop (nothing important at the top or bottom edge). GROUP SHOT of five from a low three-quarter angle, a compass layout, the emperor high at the centre. DRAW IT EXACTLY IN THE STYLE OF THE ATTACHED CHARACTER SHEET: the same clean confident black ink linework, the same manhwa face design (eye shape, brows, nose, jaw, hairline and hair). It must read as an INKED DRAWING: visible line strokes everywhere — bold tapered contour lines around every figure, drawn fold lines in the silk and armour, hair drawn as inked strands, a little cross-hatching and line shading in the shadows — then flat cel-shading in two or three tones per colour, no airbrushed gradients. Each face must be recognisably the character drawn on the sheet, wearing the same clothes. NOT realistic, NOT an oil painting, NOT photoreal, NOT painterly, NOT a 3D render, no skin pores or photographic texture. ONLY THESE FIVE PEOPLE in the frame. THE FOUR BEASTS: THE THIRD EMPEROR'S FOUR GENERALS AS GUARDIANS OF THE FOUR CARDINAL DIRECTIONS. Emperor Gaozong stands high at the exact centre on a round stepped dais that is invisible in the black, one hand half-raised, gentle and a little uneasy; only his face and the folds of his imperial yellow robe are lit, by one thin overhead shaft of pale gold light. Around him at the four compass points, each standing in a guardian pose facing outward: WEST (left) the WHITE TIGER Xue Rengui, a fangtian ji halberd upright (NOT a sword), lit ONLY by a hard bone-white rim; SOUTH (nearest the camera) the RED FOWL Su Dingfang, old and white-bearded, lit ONLY by a hard vermilion rim; EAST (right) the BLUE DRAGON Li Shiji, lit ONLY by a hard cobalt-blue rim; NORTH (behind and above the dais) the BLACK TORTOISE Liu Rengui, a calm scholar-general, lit ONLY by a cold ink-teal rim. ALMOST ENTIRELY ENCASED IN DARKNESS: every guardian is a BLACK SILHOUETTE with NO fill light at all; the only visible parts are a hard rim of light in his own colour along his helmet or hair, one cheekbone, the shoulder plates and the weapon, and his eyes. Those accent colours are the ONLY colour in the frame; everything else is black. Swords sheathed. Any sword is the ancient straight Korean ring-pommel dao: a small iron ring pommel, a short wrapped grip, a thin metal band and NO hand guard, a perfectly straight blade — never a katana, never a tsuba. CHARACTER SHEET (copy these faces, hair and clothes exactly): 1st face from the LEFT of the sheet = THE THIRD EMPEROR; 2nd face from the LEFT of the sheet = XUE RENGUI; 3rd face from the LEFT of the sheet = RED FOWL; 4th face from the LEFT of the sheet = BLUE DRAGON; 5th face from the LEFT of the sheet = BLACK TORTOISE. THE THIRD EMPEROR Colour #b8935a. | XUE RENGUI Colour #e8e3d5. | RED FOWL Colour #d95f4b. | BLUE DRAGON Colour #4b78c9. | BLACK TORTOISE — Look: Tang general of sixty-two: lean and upright, long narrow face, deep-set patient eyes, long grey moustache and a long thin grey beard to the chest, grey hair under a black Tang futou cap (or a Tang helm in battle). Dress: Tang general's round-collared robe in dark slate-green over Tang mingguang armour: two round polished chest discs, lamellar skirt, shoulder guards; a vermilion cloak; a long brush-and-tablet case at the belt. Tang palette: vermilion, black, steel. Colour #3d4a48. LIGHT AND BACKGROUND (deep manhwa tenebrism, darker than a normal splash page): about TWO-THIRDS OF THE FRAME IS PURE INK-BLACK. No set, no architecture or floor beyond what the scene names, no props beyond what the characters hold. Each figure is pulled out of the black by ONE hard, narrow key light from the side or from below in THAT PERSON'S OWN COLOUR, catching only a cheekbone, an eye, the bridge of the nose, the edge of a sleeve, a plate of armour or a hand; the rest of each figure falls off into solid black shadow and merges with the background, so neighbouring figures are separated only by their coloured edge light. Faces readable but half in shadow, eyes catching the light. At most a few thin wisps of smoke tinted by those coloured lights. Deep inky blacks, crisp highlights, hard cast shadows. Each person's colour is the colour of the light on them — never a glow aura, halo or outline glow. BLOCKING, BODY LANGUAGE AND FACIAL EXPRESSIONS show who they are to each other at a glance. Faces and clothes from the sheet; new poses, never the sheet's stance. One of each person, never cloned. No text, no lettering, no speech bubbles, no panel borders, no watermark.
